English Quest local compatibility modifications, 2026-10-21:

1. Resolve absolute model URLs before attempting a relative URL base. This fixes
   blob:null model URLs in file-origin and opaque-origin contexts, where stripping
   blob: from the worker URL yields an invalid base such as null/worker-id.
2. For blob: and data: bundled models, use the in-memory filesystem without an
   IndexedDB mount or persistent sync. The model already ships with the app;
   persistent storage must not be a prerequisite for offline operation.

3. Version 0.2.2 adds optional transferable modelData to Model and the worker load
   message. Embedded models are written straight to the worker memory filesystem
   and extracted with ArchiveHelper. No fetch of page-created Blob URLs is needed.
   Load errors include the initialization stage (engine, extraction, or model).
4. Decode the embedded WASM data URI directly rather than fetching it. The
   single-file loader and its audio self-test can now run with fetch disabled.

Original project: https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
Original npm version: 0.0.8. Original licenses and NOTICE are preserved.
Patch helper: patch-vosk.cjs. Reapplying the helper is idempotent.
